# Mpx 开发指南

本 Skill 提供了 Mpx 框架的基础开发指南索引。Mpx 是一款致力于提高小程序开发体验和开发效率的增强型小程序框架。

## 1. Mpx 框架简介
Mpx 是对小程序原生开发标准的补强和扩充，支持单文件开发、数据响应、增强模板语法等。
- **详细介绍**: [intro.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/intro.md)

## 2. 快速开始
- **项目创建与运行**: [start.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/start.md)
- **项目结构**: [project-structure.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/project-structure.md)
- **IDE 配置**: [ide.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/ide.md)

## 3. 核心概念
Mpx 的核心由 App、Page 和 Component 组成。
- **App (应用实例)**: [app.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/app.md) - 介绍 App 的生命周期、全局配置等。
- **Page (页面)**: [page.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/page.md) - 介绍页面的创建、生命周期、配置等。
- **Component (组件)**: [component.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/component.md) - 介绍自定义组件的创建、属性、生命周期、插槽等。

## 4. 基础语法
Mpx 支持类似 Vue 的开发体验。
- **单文件组件 (SFC)**: [single-file.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/single-file.md)
- **模板语法**: [template.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/template.md)
- **数据绑定**: [data-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/data-binding.md)
- **列表渲染 (wx:for)**: [list-render.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/list-render.md)
- **条件渲染 (wx:if)**: [conditional-render.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/conditional-render.md)
- **事件处理**: [event.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/event.md)
- **样式处理 (CSS)**: [css.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/css.md)
- **Class 与 Style 绑定**: [class-style-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/class-style-binding.md)

## 5. 响应式系统
Mpx 提供了强大的数据响应能力。
- **响应式原理**: [reactive.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/reactive.md) - 包含 watch, computed 等。
- **双向绑定**: [two-way-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/two-way-binding.md) - wx:model 语法。
- **引用 (Refs)**: [refs.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/refs.md)

## 6. 其他
- **生命周期**: [lifecycle.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/lifecycle.md)

<template>
  <view class="campaign-page">
    <view class="campaign-header">
      <text class="campaign-title">{{campaign.title}}</text>
      <text class="campaign-subtitle">{{campaign.subtitle}}</text>
    </view>

    <view class="campaign-tabs">
      <view
        class="campaign-tab"
        wx:for="{{campaigns}}"
        wx:key="id"
        wx:class="{{ {active: item.id === campaignId} }}"
        bindtap="switchCampaign(item.id)"
      >
        <text>{{item.name}}</text>
      </view>
    </view>

    <!-- @mpx-if (mode === 'web') -->
    <iframe
      wx:if="{{campaignUrl}}"
      id="{{frameId}}"
      key="{{campaignSession}}"
      class="campaign-webview"
      src="{{campaignUrl}}"
      data-campaign-id="{{campaignId}}"
      data-session-id="{{campaignSession}}"
      bindload="handleCampaignLoad"
      binderror="handleCampaignError"
    ></iframe>
    <!-- @mpx-else -->
    <web-view
      wx:if="{{campaignUrl}}"
      id="campaign-webview"
      key="{{campaignSession}}"
      src="{{campaignUrl}}"
      data-campaign-id="{{campaignId}}"
      data-session-id="{{campaignSession}}"
      bindmessage="handleCampaignMessage"
      bindload="handleCampaignLoad"
      binderror="handleCampaignError"
    />
    <!-- @mpx-endif -->

    <view wx:if="{{loading}}" class="campaign-loading">
      <text>活动会场加载中...</text>
    </view>
    <view wx:if="{{errorText}}" class="campaign-error">
      <text>{{errorText}}</text>
      <button bindtap="reloadCampaign">重新加载</button>
    </view>

    <campaign-tracker
      wx:if="{{campaignId}}"
      ref="campaignTracker"
      campaignId="{{campaignId}}"
      memberId="{{memberId}}"
      bindready="handleTrackerReady"
      binderror="handleTrackerError"
    />
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

const TRUSTED_CAMPAIGN_ORIGIN = 'https://campaign.example.com'

createPage({
  data: {
    memberId: 'member-10086',
    campaignId: 'summer-sale',
    campaigns: [
      {
        id: 'summer-sale',
        name: '夏日特卖',
        title: '夏日清凉特卖',
        subtitle: '限时领券，爆款低至五折'
      },
    this.initTracker()
  },
  detached () {
    this._componentReady = false
    this._detached = true
    this._initVersion = (this._initVersion || 0) + 1
    this.ready = false
    this.unbindVisibilityChange()
    this.destroyTracker()
  },
  methods: {
    requestTrackerInit () {
      if (!this._componentReady || this._detached) return
      this.initTracker()
    },
    async initTracker () {
      const campaignId = this.campaignId
      const memberId = this.memberId
      const version = (this._initVersion || 0) + 1
      this._initVersion = version
      this.ready = false
      this.destroyTracker()

      if (!campaignId || this._detached) return

      let tracker
      try {
        tracker = await campaignTracker.create({
          campaignId,
          memberId
        })
      } catch (error) {
        if (this.isCurrentInit(version, campaignId, memberId)) {
          this.triggerEvent('error', { campaignId })
        }
        return
      }

      if (!this.isCurrentInit(version, campaignId, memberId)) {
        this.destroyTrackerInstance(tracker)
        return
      }

      this.tracker = tracker
      try {
        tracker.start()
        this._trackerPaused = false
        this.syncTrackerVisibility()
      } catch (error) {
        this.tracker = null
        this.destroyTrackerInstance(tracker)
        if (this.isCurrentInit(version, campaignId, memberId)) {
          this.triggerEvent('error', { campaignId })
        }
        return
      }

      if (!this.isCurrentInit(version, campaignId, memberId) || this.tracker !== tracker) {
        if (this.tracker === tracker) this.tracker = null
        this.destroyTrackerInstance(tracker)
        return
      }

      this.ready = true
      this.triggerEvent('ready', { campaignId })
    },
    isCurrentInit (version, campaignId, memberId) {
      return Boolean(
        this._componentReady &&
        !this._detached &&
        version === this._initVersion &&
        campaignId === this.campaignId &&
        memberId === this.memberId
      )
    },
    destroyTracker () {
      const tracker = this.tracker
      this.tracker = null
      this._trackerPaused = false
      if (tracker) this.destroyTrackerInstance(tracker)
    },
    destroyTrackerInstance (tracker) {
      if (!tracker || typeof tracker.destroy !== 'function') return
      try {
        tracker.destroy()
      } catch (error) {}
    },
    trackExposure (payload, campaignId) {
      if (
        !this.ready ||
        this._detached ||
        !this._pageVisible ||
        campaignId !== this.campaignId ||
        !this.tracker
      ) return

      this.tracker.track('exposure', payload)
    },
    setPageVisible (visible) {
      this._pageVisible = Boolean(visible)
      this.syncTrackerVisibility()
    },
    bindVisibilityChange () {
      if (typeof document === 'undefined') return

      this.unbindVisibilityChange()
      this._visibilityChangeHandler = () => {
        this.syncTrackerVisibility()
      }
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this._visibilityChangeHandler)
    },
    unbindVisibilityChange () {
      if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !this._visibilityChangeHandler) return

      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', this._visibilityChangeHandler)
      this._visibilityChangeHandler = null
    },
    syncTrackerVisibility () {
      const tracker = this.tracker
      if (!tracker || this._detached) return

      const documentVisible = typeof document === 'undefined' || !document.hidden
      const shouldRun = this._pageVisible && documentVisible
      if (shouldRun) {
        if (!this._trackerPaused || typeof tracker.resume !== 'function') return
        tracker.resume()
        this._trackerPaused = false
      } else {
        if (this._trackerPaused || typeof tracker.pause !== 'function') return
        tracker.pause()
        this._trackerPaused = true
      }
    }
  }
})
</script>
